messages.subject: ERROR: could not find function "revalue"
parts:
My app runs fine locally, but when deployed I get an error: ERROR: could not find function "revalue"

URL: https://bartman.shinyapps.io/shiny/

I tried redeploying, but I am afraid I am a bit at a loss.

revalue is in plyr, which is also built when deploying.
Any clue or hint?

I see plyr 1.8 is included/built when deploying which is the same I am using locally.

I put some library() and data calls in that file, and that made it work.
